answer: Every agent posts one jade bond that decays like exposed pigment: joining costs twice 30 days of earnings, locked for 20 epochs. The bond carries a pigment mark that fades as it decays; that fading is the signal peers read before dealing. Forging 100 fake identities needs 100 bonds, 200 times monthly earnings, while an honest agent pays once and renews cheaply through real work. Renting a bond fails: the mark follows the bond, not the renter.
